notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Selvala.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Selvala.
Repeat.
